regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing-but-still-broad AI/semiconductor leadership cluster (AI Infrastructure #1, WFE #2, Memory #3, Cybersecurity #4, AI Semis #5, Non-AI Tech #6) with healthy durability and breadth, while eligible breadth is shrinking (21 of 49) and the long tail is weak/mean-reverting. The absolute-trend gate is validated for THIS market (gate_helps=true) so trend discipline has historically cut drawdown here; cross-sectional rank has no forecast edge and rotation timing is display-only, so the ranked leaders are a focus lens, not a buy list.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Infrastructure leader's breadth (0.875) declines below 0.6 while the rotation margin over WFE (currently 0.555) compresses toward zero — that combination would suggest the single leader is being absorbed into the broader semi complex, retiring the distinct AI-Infrastructure leadership read.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the confirmed rotation leader with the strongest composite (score 2.253, durability 0.73) and — more importantly for the one validated edge — high breadth (0.875) and a non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.81). The absolute-trend gate is eligible and helps on this market's history, so staying with the durable, broad, uncrowded leader is a drawdown-control logic, NOT a return forecast. I lean overweight because the gate removes the main historical failure mode (shake-outs), not because rank #1 predicts outperformance.
theses.dissent: The leader at a 2.253 score in a narrowing regime may have already captured most of its move; if the broad AI complex is late-cycle, absolute-trend eligibility only trims the downside but does not prevent the drawdown, and chasing the most extended name in a mean-reverting tail is the classic reflexivity trap.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the single strongest trend-health profile in the entire table: the highest breadth (1.0), highest durability (0.81), and a clean 'trend' hurst tag. It is crowded (z 1.91), but crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution only and never a reason to fade. With perfect breadth and durable trend structure, and the absolute-trend gate validated for this market, the directional lean is still positive even after acknowledging the crowding cap on how much to add.
theses.dissent: crowding_z 1.91 is the most extended in the table; thematic-ETF inflow and attention spikes historically mark tops, and a full-breadth trend can unravel quickly if the AI-security narrative rolls over — the crowding flag means the marginal dollar is likely late money.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: This is a counter-lean to the same subject: crowded at z 1.91 with a trend tag that has run hot, in a rotation regime where eligible breadth is narrowing (0.43) and the non-AI software complex (crowding_z 1.05) is also stretched. If the AI-security trade is reflexively late, underweighting (capping exposure) is the documented size-down response — not a fade, just refusing to add. I include this because the crowding caution is the only leg with a genuine, validated forward signal (drawdown reduction), and it points the other way.
evidence: AI agents/apps also crowded (z 1.02) suggesting broad software wash-out risk
theses.dissent: Full breadth (1.0) and top-decile durability suggest the theme is not finished; a crowded-but-durable trend can keep running, and underweighting a confirmed leader is exactly the 'fade the dominant theme' failure mode the guardrails warn against.
